CONTRACT (the doc; follow it exactly)
Returns the low median of a list of numbers: the middle value once the numbers are sorted in ascending numeric order. When the list has an even number of values there are two middle values, and the function returns the lower of the two (no averaging), so the result is always one of the input values. An empty list has no median, so the function throws a RangeError. The input array belongs to the caller and must be left exactly as it was.
